code:
use default
use IO.Std.write
use IO.Std.read_line

let size = 3

let source = System.Random(20260909)

fresh() -> LIST[int] =>
    (0..size * size) |> map(_ => source.next(2)) |> collect_list()

flip_row(board: LIST[int], row: int) is
    for column in 0..size do
        board[row * size + column] = 1 - board[row * size + column]
    od
si

flip_column(board: LIST[int], column: int) is
    for row in 0..size do
        board[row * size + column] = 1 - board[row * size + column]
    od
si

same(left: LIST[int], right: LIST[int]) -> bool =>
    (0..size * size) |> all(cell => left[cell] == right[cell])

show(caption: string, board: LIST[int]) is
    write_line(caption)

    let letters =
        (0..size) |> map(c => "{cast char(cast int('a') + c)}")

    write_line("   {letters |> join(" ")}")

    for row in 0..size do
        let cells =
            (0..size) |> map(column => "{board[row * size + column]}")

        write_line("{row + 1}  {cells |> join(" ")}")
    od

    write_line("")
si

let target = fresh()

let board = fresh()

while same(board, target) do
    flip_row(board, source.next(size))
od

show("target", target)

let moves mut = 0

while !same(board, target) do
    show("board after {moves} moves", board)

    write("move: ")

    let typed = read_line()

    if !typed? then
        write_line()
        write_line("no more input")

        break
    fi

    let move = typed.trim()

    if move.length == 1 /\ char.is_digit(move[0]) then
        flip_row(board, cast int(move[0]) - cast int('1'))
        moves = moves + 1
    elif move.length == 1 /\ char.is_letter(move[0]) then
        flip_column(board, cast int(move.to_lower()[0]) - cast int('a'))
        moves = moves + 1
    else
        write_line("enter a row number or a column letter")
    fi
od

show("board after {moves} moves", board)

if same(board, target) then
    write_line("solved in {moves} moves")
fi
